name: claude-superagent
description: DeepSeek's dsh-superagent workflow, ported to a Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: superagent
plugins.description: DeepSeek's dsh-superagent workflow for Claude Code, local-first: give work with /superagent:ask or from GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket comments. A router that only routes, one worker per ticket in its own git worktree, and a host CLI that enforces the original's rules.
